firstPlayerRule: Players choose whether to continue exploring or return to camp, then reveal their Decision cards simultaneously. There is no individual first decision turn.
clarifications: Reveal the top Expedition card before the group’s first decision. Repeat the simultaneous decisions before revealing each subsequent Expedition card.
